Examination Notice
SELECTION OF ELECTIVE COURSES
(Even Semester, December 2026 – April 2027)
We are pleased to announce elective courses for the ongoing odd semester to be offered by External
Resource Persons. All the eligible students are hereby advised to select one Elective Course of their
choice from among the following Electives Courses:

Note:
• All the students who are interested in opting Elective Courses must fill in the online MS-form by
using the link given below (shared on your university email Id) latest by 22nd November 2026 (11:59
PM) to get enrolled in the Elective Course of their choice.
Link: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/LdfvwBwNDn
• Elective Courses shall be offered subject to the availability of minimum 15 students in a particular
course. Each student will be allotted only one elective course based on his/her selection.
• Students are advised to check their eligibility and other details for the courses being offered
before submitting the form.
• Once the Elective Course has been allotted and the Course commences, the students must complete
the Course successfully, failing which the student will be marked as FAIL in the respective
Elective Course, irrespective of any reason whatsoever.
• The course on “Refugees, Forced Migrants and Non-Citizens” was offered during the previous
semester; however, it could not be commenced due to unavailability of the resource person. The
students who had opted this course in the previous semester and are interested in pursuing this
course need to register afresh.
Sd- Sd-
Academic Coordinator Controller of Examinations
Copy to: Hon’ble Vice Chancellor, Registrar’s Office, University Website, e-Notice Boards and Academic
Coordinator for information and necessary action.
